claim: For finite complete deterministic automata \(A=(Q,\{0,1\},\delta)\) whose transition graph is strongly connected, deciding whether a given subset \(S\subseteq Q\) can be synchronized—whether there exists \(w\in\{0,1\}^*\) with \(|\delta(S,w)|=1\)—is PSPACE-complete under polynomial-time many-one reductions.
integrity_notes: The proof was reconstructed from the primary paper's stated definitions and polynomial reductions. Independent audit and external validation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Worst-case decision-complexity classification only; it does not imply every subset is synchronizable, give a polynomial-time witness-finding algorithm, or determine shortest-word lengths for individual instances.
title: PSPACE-completeness of subset synchronizability for binary strongly connected automata
